policy: price/rating are null by design (unverified); 'claims' are seller statements from listing titles

products.short_name: Chefman 6 qt Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven
products.one_liner: Two independent 3 qt baskets with a sync-finish option — cook two foods at once without sharing space.
claims: 6 qt total capacity (2 × 3 qt baskets) — per listing title
Hi-Fry option and auto shutoff — per listing title
Nonstick, dishwasher-safe baskets — per listing title
products.good_for: Weeknight meals where a protein and a side need to finish together.
products.check_first: Counter width (two-basket footprint) and whether 3 qt per side fits your largest batch.

products.short_name: Emeril Lagasse 26 qt French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.one_liner: A french-door countertop oven with 24 preset modes and room for bigger formats — the toaster-oven-killer shape.
claims: 24 one-touch preset options — per listing title
Six cooking accessories included — per listing title
products.good_for: Households that want one appliance to absorb toast, bake, roast, and air-fry duty.
products.check_first: Height clearance under cabinets (french doors swing up) and the true interior rack dimensions.

products.one_liner: A big single-basket drawer with a 450 °F Hi-Fry finish step — the simplest shape for one big batch.
claims: 4-in-1: air fry, bake, dehydrate, frozen — per listing title
products.good_for: Crispy single-batch cooking with the least fuss — fries, wings, roasted vegetables.
products.check_first: Basket footprint against your counter, and whether the drawer is comfortable to load when hot.

products.one_liner: A fast-reading folding probe for spot-checking doneness — the tool that replaces the guesswork.
claims: NIST & NSF certification claimed in title — documentation not independently checked (FLG-002)
products.good_for: Spot-checking steaks, chops, and roasts quickly at the pan or grill.
products.check_first: Ask the seller what certification documents back the accuracy claim; compare probe length to your usual cuts.

products.short_name: CHEF iQ Sense Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer (Gen 3)
products.one_liner: Leave-in wireless probes with app monitoring — cook a whole bird without opening the oven door.
products.good_for: Long cooks and holiday birds where you want temperature history without lifting a lid.
products.check_first: Whether the app works on your phone's OS version, and what the warranty covers on the probes.
